behavior_review.predicate: The embedded shell adds awk/tar/lsof/shasum/md5/strings, changes jq toward jq 1.8.2 parity, and fixes ls option errors. Shell fork state changes from overlays to copy-on-write process images: background jobs, subshells and command substitutions keep fork-time variables, positional arguments, functions, aliases and options instead of observing later parent writes. behavior_review.action: On all platforms use synthetic fork-time variable/function/positional probes, a builtin-list/version/hash/jq fixture, and persistent-shell cwd/background checks. On Windows also cover owned git --version/status, external pipe/process substitution, PATH/PATHEXT and synthetic FIND/GNU/MSYS cases; use AppContainer only if that deployment mode is claimed. Inspect exact outputs and exit statuses, not model answer prose alone.
